title: UKGC RTS security-audit readiness
provenance: Explicit selection of the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 controls that RTS section 4 security requirements name, with original evidence prompts: not all Annex A controls and not the 2013 mapping. The edition names that control set. Audit advice: https://www.gamblingcommission.gov.uk/licensees-and-businesses/guide/security-audit-advice; annual audit testing strategy: https://www.gamblingcommission.gov.uk/strategy/testing-strategy-for-compliance-with-remote-gambling-and-software-technical/7-third-party-annual-security-audit; security guidance: https://www.gamblingcommission.gov.uk/licensees-and-businesses/page/technical-standards-security-requirements
license: Apache-2.0 for original MoonMind summaries. Referenced standards retain their own rights.
conclusions: Audit preparation for scoped RTS controls. The independent audit and regulator decisions remain external.

externalClaims.gap: Supplied records are preparation evidence; MoonMind has not independently verified an external audit or private inspection.
externalClaims.verifiableBy: Qualified independent auditor and operator evidence owner
externalClaims.nextStep: Have the independent auditor examine the recorded enquiry, evidence and observation for each selected control and issue the audit report.

externalClaims.gap: No regulator submission has been performed and no Gambling Commission decision is inferred.
externalClaims.nextStep: Submit the full audit report, and any major nonconformity, under the reporting conditions recorded here.

limitations: Preparation evidence only. Independent audit and private inspection remain Unverified.
No regulator submission has been performed.
